name: Ristegio's Restaurant & Lounge

evidence.note: Review mentions asking for a table near the dance floor to see a band.
Band's event page invites guests to have dinner and then hit the dance floor at Ristegio's.
Band billed its Ristegio's show as a 70s/80s dance party.

dancing.notes: The lounge has a dance floor in front of the band. Soul, Motown and rock party bands play most weekends, and diners get up to dance after dinner.

description: A New American restaurant, lounge and catering hall on Medford Avenue (Route 112) in North Patchogue, with sushi, steaks and live bands on weekend nights.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Ira's List venue page (/ristegios) gives 641 Medford Ave (Rt 112), Patchogue, 631-731-3663. The area is often called North Patchogue; some listings show 639 Medford Ave or 641 Medford Ave #112. The Music Express gig not checked on the venue calendar.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Social links differ on the site: the header links facebook.com/ristegiosrestaurant/ and instagram.com/ristegios_restaurant/, while the footer and structured data link facebook.com/ristegios and instagram.com/ristegios (our current value). We chose the header ones because posts show them in use; the other handles may be old or redirect. Hours: the visible footer says Tue-Thu 12-10, Fri-Sat 12-midnight, Sun 12-9; the structured data says Tue-Thu 4-10, Fri-Sat 4-11, Sun 1-9; we used the visible footer. Structured data calls the town North Patchogue (mail address Patchogue 11772). Email is a Gmail address published as the business contact. Only one usable photo on the site (exterior, black and white). The Music Express gig on Oct 3 is confirmed on the venue's live music page.
hours: Tue-Thu 12 PM-10 PM; Fri-Sat 12 PM-12 AM; Sun 12 PM-9 PM; closed Mon. Live bands Fri-Sat 8 PM-11 PM

logo.alt: Ristegio's logo: the name written in gold script

photos.alt: Black and white photo of Ristegio's brick building with dark awnings and a stone sign with a large R out front

evidence.note: Restaurant site footer: 641 Medford Avenue, Patchogue, NY 11772, 631-731-3663, Ristegios@gmail.com, hours, OpenTable link; header and footer link Facebook, Instagram and YouTube.
Live music page lists bands on Friday and Saturday nights, 8-11 PM, including Music Express Dance Band on Sat Oct 3, 2026 (confirms the gig in our data).
A post on the ristegiosrestaurant Facebook page tags @ristegios_restaurant on Instagram, so these look like the active accounts.
